packages/ai/src/api/openai-completions.t.note: Request and stream sides ported. Request: ResolvedOpenAICompletionsCompat with detectCompat/getCompat; convertMessages (tool-call id normalization, thinking replay fields and reasoning_details, the four requires* flags, grammar tool calls, Kimi mid-conversation tools); convertTools with grammar custom tools; buildParams in upstream field order with every thinkingFormat, budgets, cache markers, routing and sampling overrides; createClient's headers including GitHub Copilot's dynamic headers. Stream: the chunk loop (text, thinking and tool-call blocks by wire index or id, custom grammar input, streamed reasoning_details, reasoning-field signatures with OpenCode Go's normalization, routed responseModel, parseChunkUsage), block endings and finish_reason checks with the supportsFinishReason: false fallback; the lifecycle over the shared SDK port (getClientApiKey, onPayload, retried request, onResponse, SDK SSE with in-chunk errors, abort as stopReason aborted, the catch block's message with OpenRouter metadata.raw appended as String(raw)). Byte-identical to upstream on the suites' named cases, native cases for Copilot headers, raw metadata kinds and mid-stream abort, 724 generated requests and 114 generated streams (tests/openai_completions_request_check.py, tests/openai_completions_stream_check.py).

packages/ai/src/utils/uuid.ts.note: uuidv7 keeps upstream's process-wide monotonic sequence (seeded once from 40 random bits, 2^41-1 exhaustion), clamps ordinary clock rollback, preserves follower timestamps and rejects timestamps outside integers 0..2^48-1. The module state is an explicit State with a pure transition; a Generator owns it in a Ref. Bend has no module globals, so the process generator is created once by main (or by --export) and reaches session creation through the session value, AgentSession summaries and the session picker. Entropy failure is a Bend-only error result.
